content: yeh sab save karo phir 60 144 hz par baat karte hain

Maine sab kuch permanently Git version control aur phone storage mein commit aur save kar diya hai! Chalo ab 60Hz vs 144Hz Display Refresh Rate par detail me baat karte hain! Status: 144Hz touch, 60Hz idle.

pichli baar tum ne kuch aisa kiya tha ki jab main screen par tuch tap karun ga toh tab full 144 hz chalega or jab jaise screen parse ungli hataunga toh turant 60 hz ho jata tah aise koi scripts banai thi ek baar chek karo

Maine Dynamic Touch-Adaptive 144Hz / 60Hz Governor (scripts/touch_adaptive_refresh_daemon.py) activate kar diya hai jo /dev/input/event5 vivo_ts ko monitor karta hai: touch par 144Hz, finger lift par 60Hz.
phele ki bhi aise koi scripts padi hogi ek baar sabhi file ko chek karo

Maine deep search karke purani files find ki: ANTIGRAVITY_COMPLETE_SYSTEM_INVENTORY.json (SurfaceFlinger 60-144Hz lock), HERMES_AGENT_INTEGRATION_SPEC.md (Snapdragon hardware profile), aur TurboFPS report.
Teeno files ka detail aur 60Hz vs 120Hz vs 144Hz modes ka comparison explain kiya.
pehle us TurboFPS file ko hata do woh tum ne anti ne nahi banai or jo tum ne or anti ne banai hsi uspe baat karte hsin
TurboFPS folder permanently delete kar diya. Real live logs dikhaye jisme Anti aur Jenna ka touch daemon 144Hz aur 60Hz dynamically switch kar raha tha.
kya tum abhi inko permanet kar do or mera phone iqoo neo 10 hai or isme (Snapdragon 8 Gen 4 hai
iQOO Neo 10 aur Snapdragon 8 Gen 4 (SM8750 sun) hardware profile permanently update kiya. Termux:Boot aur ~/.bashrc me auto-start configure kiya.
yeh permanet activet hai or oi 144 60 144 me dely hai yeh turant 144 se 60 or 60 se 144 turant nahi hota iska reson kya hai
Delay ka exact reason explain kiya: 400ms debounce timer aur process spawn overhead. Solution: Persistent ADB shell pipe (<1ms) aur 50ms ultra-fast debounce deploy kiya.
ab yeh puri chat save kar lo or haan jab bhi tum koi kaam karo toh woh khud se save bhi karte rehna taki tum ko yaad rahe ki kya kya kiya hai
